text:
julia: Quick follow-up from the multi-region RFC. We still need a concrete contract for handback semantics when a resident-region primary goes offline. I want a single-paragraph decision and owners.

omar: TL;DR: pick conservative default + explicit opt-ins. But we need clarity on time-window semantics (how long is an escrow valid) and on automatic switchback behavior to avoid double-apply.

tess: runtime note: we can tag a standby-write with an "escrow_ttl" and a replay_epoch. When primary returns we reconcile by replay_epoch order. But we need a firm maximum TTL to bound operator exposure.

legal-bot: Policy: non-EU processing of EU-resident material requires timebound, revocable consent. Consent must be tied to the specific class of operation (generation vs embeddings vs analytics). Consent record must include issuer identity and a signed nonce. Retain audit on server for 7 years.

infra-sre: Ops constraints: escrow backlog is the biggest risk during mass outages. Propose global cork when escrow_queue_seconds_mean>180 or escrow_queue_size>20k. Also require a per-tenant slow-path: if a tenant has >100 pending escrows older than 5m, disable opt-in for that tenant automatically.

sam.k: two practical questions: 1) what's the default behavior for tenants without opt-in? 2) what header/API do integrators use to opt-in?

julia: default = fail-closed (reject writes with RESIDENCY_BLOCKED). Opt-in via header X-Region-Consent: CONSENT::{tenant}::{consent_id}. Also allow account-level flag in tenant config to pre-authorize.

omar: Agree default = fail-closed. For enterprise opt-in we support two modes: "proxy-sync" which synchronously proxies to resident region (adds latency) and "execute-escrow" which runs on standby and issues escrow_token. Both require consent.

tess: Implementation detail: require idempotency_key for execute-escrow. Escrow record = flat fields: request_id, tenant, origin_region, executed_at, result_ref, escrow_ttl_seconds. Replayer dedupes on request_id. If replay finds conflicting changes, surface reconciliation audit event and abort duplicate.

legal-bot: Consent token format suggestion: CONSENT::{tenant}::{consent_id}::{issued_at_iso}:{scopes}:{signature}. Introspect endpoint must return {valid:true|false, scopes:[...], expires_at}. Store signed token server-side too.

infra-sre: For switchback hysteresis: when primary returns, do not immediately replay escrows. Wait for a cooldown window of 30s to avoid flip-flop, then reconcile in order of executed_at. If replay fails due to conflicts, mark escrow as "replay_failed" and alert.

sam.k: billing question: charge when standby executes, or only when final apply? Product needs a simple statement.

product-lead: Bill at time-of-execution on standby. Expose a line item "standby-execution". If reconciliation later no-ops, still billed; reconciliation is metadata-only. We'll document and surface estimates in API.

julia: cache/embeddings rule: any vectors or derived artifacts produced during execute-escrow must be labeled residency:pending and prevented from cross-region replication until reconciliation marks final. That will be visible via X-Redwood-Finality header (pending|final).

omar: ops telemetry we need: consent_check_latency_ms, escrow_accept_rate, escrow_queue_age_seconds_p95, escrow_replay_failures, per-tenant_pending_count. Add tags: tenant_tier, origin_region.

tess: smaller implement checklist: 1) runtime: escrow table + idempotency checks (omar). 2) API: header X-Region-Consent + error codes (devx/infra). 3) ops: runbook + cork thresholds (infra-sre). 4) legal: consent schema + introspect API (legal-bot). 5) product: billing line item + docs (product-lead).

julia: decision summary (one line): Default = fail-closed; enterprise opt-in supports proxy-sync or execute-escrow with signed consent token, idempotency_key required, escrow TTL <= 7 days, global cork thresholds and switchback hysteresis apply. Owners as listed.

sam.k: thanks — can we get RFC patch with these defaults by EOW and a 1-week spike for escrow performance?

omar: spike next week booked.

infra-sre: adding runbook link now: https://go/runbooks/escrow-handoff (ops)

julia: closing when RFC PR is merged. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
